visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A title card with the question "解放軍為什麼會被大清洗?" (Why is the PLA being purged?) is shown. A young man with dark hair, wearing a black collared jacket over a dark shirt, stands in a dark studio. He speaks with a serious expression, gesturing with his hands. (2) A screenshot of a digital news article from "公視新聞網" (PTS News) appears, titled "共軍高層涉職務犯罪 何衛東等9人遭開除黨、軍籍" (PLA top brass involved in duty crimes; 9 including He Weidong expelled). The host's voice continues as the visual focuses on the headline and key text. (3) The visual shifts to show portraits of military generals in uniform, specifically He Weidong and Lin Xiangyang. They are presented as stills from news reports or official photos. Xi Jinping is also shown in a split-screen or separate photo, looking solemn during a political meeting. (4) The host returns to center screen, explaining the context of the purge. He uses a finger-pointing gesture for emphasis. Yellow text boxes with black text pop up to highlight names and titles like "軍委副主席 何衛東". (5) A montage of news clips from international outlets like the BBC and CNN is shown, highlighting the global coverage of the event. The host is seen in the corner or through a cutaway. (6) A silhouette of a man in a business suit walking down a brightly lit corridor is shown to represent the "disappearance" or removal of officials. (7) The host concludes by pointing toward the bottom of the screen, where a call-to-action button for his YouTube channel is visible. The lighting is bright and focused on the host throughout.
